scope: Local upright neighborhood and one observed stalled-state recovery; no arbitrary-placement or reserved-test claim

training.recovery_from: baseline timeout at train-yplus2; restore once as a new episode

selection: Fit on old five plus verified new training episodes only. Tune on development only. Freeze checkpoint and source hashes before running baseline and candidate once each on held-out starts. Never train on or change these held-out results afterward in this milestone.
promotion: Candidate must improve development successes, retain all five familiar successes, and improve held-out successes without weakening physical criteria. Otherwise preserve current browser model.
failures: Record failed teacher/replay attempts; do not label them eligible or substitute test poses. A failed recovery is a reported limitation, not a successful demonstration.
